coachWaitingDetail.message: Open claude.ai and send a message — the coach starts once it can see your limits.

coachHitDetail.message: Resets in $P1$. Line up what you'll ask next so you can go straight to it.

coachRiskTitle.message: $P1$: on pace to run out in $P2$

coachRiskSessionDetail.message: That's $P1$ before it resets. Switch routine work to a lighter model and lower the effort to stretch it.

coachRiskWeeklyDetail.message: That's $P1$ before it resets. To make it last, stay under ~$P2$% a day.

coachExpensiveDetail.message: Each message here costs ~$P1$% of your limit — $P2$× your usual. Start a new chat with a short summary of where you are.

coachExpensiveDetailNoRatio.message: Each message here costs ~$P1$% of your limit. Start a new chat with a short summary of where you are.

coachLongDetail.message: $P1$ messages in — every reply processes the whole conversation. A fresh chat with a summary costs far less.

coachUnderTitle.message: $P1$% of your weekly limit resets in $P2$

coachUnderDetail.message: You're on track to use only ~$P1$% this week. Unused capacity doesn't roll over — a good time for big jobs.

coachOnPaceDetail.message: Your usage fits comfortably within this window.

coachMsgsLeftSession.message: About $P1$ more messages this session at your recent average.

coachMsgsLeftWeekly.message: About $P1$ more messages this week at your recent average.

tipNewChat.message: Start a new chat for each new task. Paste a 3–5 line summary instead of carrying the whole history along.

tipCredits.message: Need to keep going? Turn on usage credits in Settings › Usage — billed at API rates, with a monthly cap you choose.

tipModel.message: Use Sonnet or Haiku for everyday work and save Opus and Fable for hard problems — they use your limit much faster.

tipEffort.message: Turn extended thinking off, or pick a lower effort level, for routine questions — higher effort uses more tokens.

tipTools.message: Turn off web search, Research and connectors you don't need in this chat — tools are token-heavy.

tipFable.message: Fable has its own weekly limit and you've used $P1$% of it. Keep it for your hardest tasks.

tipBudget.message: Budget about $P1$% of your weekly limit per day so it lasts until the reset.

tipUnder.message: Use the spare capacity before the reset: Research reports, long documents, or that big refactor.

tipBatch.message: Ask related questions together in one message instead of several short follow-ups.

tipProjects.message: Keep documents you reuse in a Project — cached project content counts less against your limits than re-uploading.

tipEditPrompt.message: If a reply misses the mark, edit your original message instead of adding a correction — the chat stays shorter.

tipContextUpfront.message: Give all the context up front (goal, constraints, the full snippet) so Claude gets it right the first time.

tipSharedLimits.message: Claude Code and the desktop app share these same limits — heavy coding sessions drain your chat budget too.

strategyFree.message: Free plan: a small session allowance. Keep chats short and focused, and start a new chat for each topic.

strategyPro.message: Pro: the 5-hour session usually runs out first. Default to Sonnet, spread heavy work across sessions, and watch the weekly bar on busy weeks.

strategyMax.message: Max: 5× Pro per session and per week, plus a separate weekly Fable limit. The weekly bar is the one to pace — about 14% a day.

strategyUltra.message: Ultra: no 5-hour limit once your account is verified — only the weekly limits matter. Pace about 14% a day and keep Fable for hard problems.

strategyTeam.message: Team: limits are per seat, so the Pro habits apply — lighter models for routine work, new chats for new topics.

paceNotifBody.message: At your current pace you'll hit it in $P1$, $P2$ before it resets. Switch to a lighter model or start a fresh chat to stretch it.

paceTickTitle.message: Even pace — where your usage would be if spread evenly across this window

pillMsgsLeftTitle.message: Estimated messages left in this window, based on what your recent messages cost

pillDailyBudgetTitle.message: Share of your weekly limit you can use per day and still last until it resets

pillUsedTodayTitle.message: Share of your weekly limit used since midnight

paceAlertsLabel.message: Warn me before I run out

paceAlertsHint.message: A notification when you're on pace to hit a limit before it resets — within the hour for the session, within a day for weekly limits.
